Rizqflow stores all your financial data only in this app's storage on this device, separate for each account. There's no server, no third-party tracker, and no ads.

Signing in with Google only uses your identity (name, email, profile photo) to open your workspace; we don't read your contacts or files. If you connect Gmail, that access is only used to recognize transaction receipts and is never sent to anyone else.

Signing in with a username and password stores the password as a hash, not plain text, and only on your device.

Uninstalling the app deletes all your data with no backup elsewhere. Export and encrypted backup are coming in a future version.

resources.string: Due-date reminders, pay with one tap

Add electricity, internet, installments, or taxes. Rizqflow reminds you three days before, on the due date, and once if it is late. The expense is only recorded when you tap Pay, because the payment itself happens outside the app.
